response.overview: Every Christmas, a father and his daughter capture a photograph together beneath the same Christmas tree, documenting the beautiful journey of their lives as she grows from a little girl into a young woman. Through an old family album, we witness the passage of time, their evolving relationship, and the countless little moments that make their bond special. But as the years pass, the photographs take a heartbreaking turn, revealing the daughter's illness and eventual absence from his life. Now, alone on Christmas, the father finds an unexpected letter tucked away among her belongings. A gift from his daughter, it reveals that she had secretly repaid his home loan, fulfilling a dream he had worked towards all his life. In a moment of overwhelming emotion, he discovers that even though she is no longer beside him, her love continues to embrace him. A poignant story about the enduring bond between a parent and child, and a love that transcends time, distance, and even death.
response.title: Merry Christmas
